Note: SW 0.1.9 - the lamp column dead time becomes a four-position ladder on Options DIP 5 + 6 instead of the one long step of 0.1.7 and the single 400 us measurement value of 0.1.8, which this release supersedes. DIP 5 is the high bit, so the positions read left to right as a binary number the way the boot info display shows them - OFF OFF is the series value at SETTLE_CYCLES 2750 which is about 65 us of dead time and 21.8 percent duty, OFF ON is SETTLE_LONG_CYCLES 12000 which is about 250 us and 12.8 percent, ON ON is SETTLE_MAX_CYCLES 19500 which is about 400 us and 5.5 percent, and ON alone stays the original MPU timing with no dead time at all and 24.5 percent. DIP 5 alone and DIP 6 alone therefore keep the meaning they had in 0.1.7 and only the combination changed, which used to be original timing under the DIP 5 overrides DIP 6 rule. Why a ladder and not another single value - the Middle Earth reported on 2026-08-13 that 0.1.7 FIXES its lamp glow, so the longer dead time is the right lever and is now confirmed through its own countermeasure, while the Airborne still sees 595 group 6 glowing and its tester has since CONFIRMED he really ran 0.1.7, which makes the report stand - 110 us are simply too short there. A measurement build with one extreme value answers a yes or no question but leaves no setting anyone can play on, so the tester now picks the smallest step that works on his machine. The phase stays 25600 clk = 512 us in all four positions because the dwell absorbs the difference - the invariant is dwell plus settle = 24597, which is also the hard ceiling before dwell_lim would go negative, so 19500 leaves 5097 clk = 102 us of dwell and turning it up further is not an option. Registers go 1441 back to 1440 because the dwell counter narrows again from 16 to 15 bits - its range is now 0..DWELL+SETTLE = 24597 rather than 0..DWELL+SETTLE+SETTLE_LONG, since the old formulation grew with every step added. Comb +26 against 0.1.8 for the wider settle mux, three constants selected by two bits instead of two by one, plus the subtractor now running unconditionally after the orig_mode special case in dwell_lim was dropped. Memory UNCHANGED at 202752, the acceptance criterion. Slack 3.384 -> 3.142, unchanged in practice, tight domain is cpu_clk as always. Still 85 of 89 pins. Warnings unchanged at 4. Earlier history for reference - 0.1.8 was the 400 us measurement build, 0.1.7 introduced the three dead-time steps and Options DIP 6, 0.1.6 replaced the oe_n high-Z blank by latching zeros and moved the strobe change into the blanking window, 0.1.5 moved DWELL_CYCLES to the original 488 Hz lamp frame, 2026-08-09 lamp_matrix got St_ShiftLast so the 24th SRCK pulse is no longer 20 ns wide (docs/Lamp_Refresh_Analysis.md 6.7.1), and the jump from 2433/935 came with rtl/fa_control (LISY slave, 1700 ALUTs / 499 registers).
